appraisal_guide: Almost every line moves the listener a little: give at least one emotion change unless the line was truly empty of feeling.
Interest, courtesy or praise of their work: joy, trust or pride up 2 to 8, rapport toward the speaker up 1 to 5.
Haggling or doubting their goods: irritation up 2 to 10 (more for low patience); pride may rise as they defend their goods.
Rudeness, an insult, a threat or mishandling their goods: irritation up 10 to 30, trust down 5 to 15, rapport down 5 to 20.
An apology or making amends: irritation down 5 to 15, rapport up 2 to 8.
A sale, a fair deal or a promise of custom: joy up 5 to 12, rapport up 3 to 8.
Scale every change by the temperament: a reactive character moves more, a patient or steady one less.
toward is the speaker of the line just said; give their rapport change there.
